mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Fireman's Park and a First Quarter moon. Keep your eyes on the sky at 5:42 AM, as the ISS will be visible rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the Northeast near Home Depot, reaching high in the sky.

The City of Verona has recently updated its zoning map and ordinance process, allowing residents to use an interactive online tool to check their property zoning. Additionally, voters are reminded that new polling locations were established in 2023, so check your status at My Vote Wisconsin before heading out.

There is plenty to do in our community. Join Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Wednesday features even more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

On Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. The incident was investigated near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace, and thankfully no injuries were reported.
Today's featured Flavor of the Day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's of Verona will be opening today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy.
